_comment: traps.md Y10 - the date reads 'Jan 9, 20yy'. That is a template placeholder, not a year, so documentDate is null. Inventing a plausible year here would silently reorder the whole timeline, which is exactly the failure FR-4.1 exists to prevent. 'Tabs No. 30' is a dispensed quantity, not a duration; at one tablet daily that implies 30 days, but the document does not say so and the label does not infer it.

medications.sourceText: Lipitor 10 mg  Tabs No. 30  Sig: tab i every day
